[[File:Clue scroll (hard) detail.png|left|150px]]
<span lang="ar" dir="rtl">A</span> '''clue scroll (hard)''', more commonly referred to as a '''hard clue''', is a rare drop from a variety of high-levelled [[monsters]]. The clue is part of the [[Treasure Trail]]s activity, and sends players across [[Gielinor]] and other [[realms]] to complete it. Completing a trail rewards players with a [[casket (hard)|casket]] containing several random items, some of which are very rare and valuable. 

Hard clue scrolls can be ''between 4 and 6 steps'' long, and are longer, more dangerous, and have harder requirements than previous tiers of clues. In addition to needing to complete puzzle boxes, players may have to enter the [[Wilderness]], as well as fight [[Zamorak wizard|Zamorakian]] or [[Saradomin wizard|Saradominist wizards]] and the [[double agent]]. 

When completing a hard clue, the message {{Mes|Well done, you've completed the Treasure Trail!}} appears, followed by messages indicating the number of hard clues the player has completed and an approximate [[GE value]] of the reward; for example, {{Mes|You have completed 87 hard Treasure Trails.|colour=Red}} {{Mes|Your treasure is worth around 217,997 coins!|colour=Red}}

Completion of the [[Hard Combat Achievements|hard combat tasks]] gives a 5% increased chance to receive a hard clue scroll from all sources, excluding [[implings]]. Hard clues can also be given to [[Watson]] along with an [[easy clue|easy]], [[medium clue|medium]] and [[elite clue scroll]], in return for a [[master clue scroll]]. Furthermore, each reward casket from a hard clue has a 1/15 chance of containing a master clue scroll.

Completing 300 hard clues rewards the player with the [[Uri transform]] emote.

==Mechanics==
===Dying with a scroll===
As clue scrolls are untradeable, they are sent to the [[gravestone]] if unprotected on [[PvP]] or [[PvM]] death, even above level 20 [[Wilderness]]. [[Clue box]]es are not necessary and only add additional risk when in the Wilderness.

===Multiple clues===
As with all tiers of clue scrolls, only one hard clue scroll can be held, kept in Death's Office, or stored in a bank at one time; attempting to open a [[scroll box (hard)]] while holding a hard clue scroll gives the message {{mes|The clue box refuses to open - you already have a clue.}} However, it is possible to drop clues on the floor, where they'll stay for one hour, allowing players to have multiple clues at once. Dropping prior clue scrolls while having done some of their steps does NOT retain the steps of the dropped clue when starting a new one.

===Casting an alchemy spell===
When casting an alchemy spell on a clue scroll, if the game setting that triggers a warning on untradeable items is disabled, a different confirmation warning is triggered, asking "wouldn't you rather solve the clue?". If the game setting is enabled, only the regular question is triggered.

==Possible rewards==
{{Main|Reward casket (hard)}}

The average loot roll is worth {{Coins|floor({{HardClueValue}})}}. On average, hard clues are worth {{Coins|floor(5 * {{HardClueValue}})}}. The 1/15 chance of receiving a master clue scroll adds another {{Coins|floor(1/15 * 6 * {{MasterClueValue}})}}, for a total expected value per clue of {{Coins|floor(5 * {{HardClueValue}} + 1/15 * 6 * {{MasterClueValue}})}}.

{{Clue scroll (hard)/Rewards}}
